dedupe_keys.name: open road risk an open data pipeline for exposure adjusted collision risk on the gb road network

description: The Open Road Risk author publishes a staged software pipeline for collision-risk scores on Great Britain road links. Zenodo archives version 0.1.0 under MIT and links the code repository. The README describes traffic estimation from DfT counts, within-day profiles from WebTRIS and a link-year collision model using STATS19, OS Open Roads geometry, OSM and area context. Risk is adjusted for traffic exposure before link ranking. This model can supply road-safety and disruption assumptions in transport simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this pipeline. Coverage is Great Britain and source years 2015–2024, with several upstream datasets fetched separately. A limitation is that many links lack direct traffic counts; predicted exposure and collision risk carry model error. Current repository performance notes include an earlier leaked evaluation metric that should not be reused. The archived code was not run and risk scores were not independently checked.
